verdict: Read the file carefully before you get excited about the brand: the word 'epiFi' appears only in the ATS slug and URL. All four descriptions are for Tetriz, an AI Engineering Intelligence platform that measures how teams use Cursor, Claude Code and Copilot — a small team where you work 'directly with the founders', not Fi Money's neobank. That is good news for Omkar's fit and bad news for his 15 LPA number. Three of the four roles (AI Engg, DS/ML, GenAI Product Builder) are the single best requirement-match he will see for his agentic AI work, because this is a company whose entire product thesis is that AI-native builders are worth more — but all four are stipend-paid internships in Bengaluru, and the money only arrives through conversion.
channel: Two-track, simultaneously. Track 1: apply on Lever, but to a MAXIMUM of two roles — this is a four-req board at a tiny company and applying to all four reads as spray-and-pray to a founder who sees every application. Track 2, which matters more here: find the Tetriz founders on LinkedIn/X and send a build-first DM — one paragraph, a link to the KOP AI repo, a 90-second Loom showing the 60-90s to 8-12s latency drop, and one sentence on what he'd instrument about Claude Code usage if he joined. At this company size the founder reads it. The Lever form is likely to auto-filter him on availability (he cannot start until January), so the DM is the channel that survives that filter.
may2027: Structurally excellent, calendar-wise risky. These are internships, which is exactly the shape he needs — he is free January-May 2027 and cannot take a full-time req before June 2027, so an internship here is worth more to him than a full-time posting elsewhere. But these were posted in September 2026 by a small team that ships fast, and the language throughout ('ship fast', 'real ownership from week one', 'available full-time, in office, for the full six months') says they want someone now, not in fifteen weeks. He is in his 7th semester until December and cannot be full-time in Bengaluru before ~5 January 2027. So: apply now, lead with availability rather than burying it, and explicitly ask whether a January cohort exists. Then nudge again in mid-November when the current intern batch is settled and the next one is being planned. The declared line should be identical on every application: 'Available full-time, in office in Bengaluru, 5 January 2027 through 30 June 2027; B.Tech CSE…
ctc: Be blunt: none of these four clears 15 LPA, because none of them is a full-time role. Realistic intern stipend at a seed/early-Series-A Bengaluru AI devtools startup: Rs 30,000-60,000/month for the engineering and DS/ML roles (possibly 60-80k if they're funded well and competing for AI talent), Rs 20,000-40,000/month for product marketing. Annualised that is 4-9 LPA equivalent — nowhere near target. The real number is the PPO the AI Engg posting hints at and the marketing posting states outright ('a full-time offer on the table for interns who perform'): a converted FT AI/ML engineer at a company like this in mid-2027 is realistically 14-24 LPA fixed plus ESOPs that are worth zero until an…
